text: CORPA, or GOAT, a genus of quadrupeds belongings to the order of pecors. The horna are hollow, tanned upwards, reefs, and fachoon. There are eight forecasted in the under joy, and soon in the upper upper and they have no dog seeds. This genus conflicts of 14 freers, etc.

parsed.faithful: CAPRA, or GOAT, a genus of quadrupeds belonging to the order of pecora. The horns are hollow, turned upwards, erect, and feabrous. There are eight fore-teeth in the under jaw, and none in the upper; and they have no dog-teeth. This genus conflicts of 14 species, etc.
